(()=>{if(document.querySelector('#sound').getAttribute('aria-pressed')!=='false')throw Error('Audio activado sin gesto');window.createdContexts=0;const Native=window.AudioContext;window.AudioContext=class extends Native{constructor(...args){super(...args);window.createdContexts++;window.testContext=this;}createOscillator(){const o=super.createOscillator();window.testOscillator=o;return o;}createGain(){const g=super.createGain();window.testGain=g;return g;}};})()

(()=>{if(createdContexts!==1||testContext.state!=='running'||document.querySelector('#sound').getAttribute('aria-pressed')!=='true')throw Error('El gesto no activó el sonido');const expected=+document.querySelector('.laboratory').dataset.tone;if(Math.abs(testOscillator.frequency.value-expected)>1)throw Error('Frecuencia inicial incorrecta');if(testGain.gain.value<.024)throw Error('Sonido inaudible');})()

(()=>{if(+document.getElementById('eccentricity').value!==.0167)throw Error('No recuperó la excentricidad de Tierra');const expected=+document.querySelector('.laboratory').dataset.tone;if(Math.abs(testOscillator.frequency.value-expected)>1)throw Error('No seleccionó el tono de Tierra');Object.defineProperty(document,'hidden',{value:true,configurable:true});document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange'));})()
(()=>{if(testGain.gain.value>.0001)throw Error('Audio activo en pestaña oculta');delete document.hidden;document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange'));})()

(()=>{if(document.querySelector('#sound').getAttribute('aria-pressed')!=='false'||testGain.gain.value>.0001)throw Error('No se pudo silenciar');return 'Audio explícito, selección, frecuencia y silencios correctos';})()
